genre_name: Cancer dependency or drug-target selectivity analysis from CRISPR screens (DepMap-style)
scope: Analyses of genome-wide or focused CRISPR knockout (and RNAi) screens across many cancer cell lines (DepMap/Achilles, Project Score, DRIVE, integrated sets) using gene-effect scores to find selective dependencies, synthetic-lethal or paralog dependencies, biomarkers that predict dependency, target-priority scores, or concordance between genetic dependency and drug response (PRISM, GDSC, CTRP) to judge on-target selectivity. Covers computational-only papers and papers where a DepMap analysis leads into wet-lab validation. Does not cover single-cell-line screen papers without cross-cell-line analysis, in vivo screens, CRISPR library or tool-design papers, or reviews.
word_count_convention: jats_structure.py prose words; captions/tables/citations/headings excluded; main = I+M+R+D(+L,C); STAR Methods counted as Methods (minus Resource availability)

standard_items.text: Dependencies are measured in cultured cell lines (mostly 2D, in vitro) that do not capture the tumour microenvironment or in vivo context.
CRISPR screen noise and artefacts (copy-number cutting toxicity, guide efficiency, off-target effects) or CRISPR-RNAi discordance may distort gene-effect scores.
Few cell lines for some lineages or rare biomarkers limit power; under-represented cancer types give less reliable results.
Only some feature classes were tested (e.g. mutations but not copy number, methylation or protein), so many dependencies stay unexplained.
Associations are computational predictions that need experimental validation.
Results depend on chosen thresholds or hyperparameters (e.g. wild-type P cut-off, number of components).
Screens contain no healthy-tissue models, so a therapeutic window (toxicity of targeting a pan-essential or selective gene) cannot be judged.

variation_notes: Venue house style drives most structural variation. Cell Press (E2, E4, E10): STAR Methods after Discussion with Key Resources Table, Resource availability, Highlights, In brief, graphical abstract and a mandatory 'Limitations of the study' subsection; STAR Methods can exceed 5,000-8,000 words. Nature family (E3, E7, E9): Methods last, separate Data and Code availability, Reporting Summary (E3, E9), editor's summary, Extended Data (E9). BMC (E1): structured abstract, separate Conclusions, Declarations block. EMBO (E6): Expanded View figures, Synopsis, Reagents and Tools table. OUP NAR Cancer (E5): classic IMRaD with Methods second. PLOS (E8): Author summary and front-matter statements. Design drives the rest: the 4 computational-only papers (E1, E2, E5, E6) replace validation figures with benchmarks against known positives and independent screens; the 6 papers with wet-lab work (E3, E4, E7, E8, E9, E10; heaviest in E8, E9) spend 2-6 main figures on validation.
lint_notes: Require a named screen release with version (regex \b(19|2\d)Q[1-4]\b or 'DepMap Public') in Methods or Data availability; 8/10 exemplars give one. Prefer the figshare/figshare+ DOI as a dataset reference.
Require the gene-effect model to be named (Chronos/CERES/DEMETER2/BAGEL/MAGeCK) and a multiple-testing method (FDR/BH/q-value/Bonferroni); both are near-universal.
Require at least one biomarker-association figure (volcano or score-vs-P/bubble) with an FDR threshold stated in the caption, and a gene-effect distribution figure for the headline dependency.
When the paper claims drug-target selectivity, require a dependency-vs-drug-response figure (PRISM/GDSC/CTRP) or explicitly say no drug-response data were used.
Require recovery of known positives (known dependencies, known SL pairs, gold-standard drug-target pairs) to be reported in Results (10/10).
Require lineage handling: results by cancer type or lineage as a covariate (8/10 report lineage-level results).

Do not require validation panels, cell-line authentication or a Reporting Summary for Amani (computational only); instead require the limitation 'computational predictions need experimental validation' even though only 3/10 exemplars state it, because none of Amani's papers have wet-lab work.
Top-hit lists belong in supplementary spreadsheets (9/10), not main-text tables (0/10); main text holds 0-2 tables.
Main display items 5-8 (median 6.5; figures 4-7, median 6). Count Key Resources/Reagents tables, Highlights and graphical abstracts separately.
Abstract: one unstructured paragraph of about 150 words (Cell Press cap 150; up to 250 for OUP/npj/BMC), naming the resource and the association; a quantitative result is optional (2/10).
Methods-last order is the norm (9/10); IMRaD with Methods second is a venue variant (OUP).
notes: Exemplar selection: 10 OA papers 2022-2025 from Cell Press (3), Nature family (3), BMC, EMBO, OUP and PLOS (1 each). Four are computational-only on public screen data (E1, E2, E5, E6); six include wet-lab work (validation share 6/10; E8 and E9 are wet-lab dominated after a DepMap starting point).

Cancer Cell exemplar (Pacini et al. 2024, Project Score target prioritisation) was wanted but has no PMC full text; two Cell Systems/Cell Reports candidates (PMC9035054, PMC9022184) had no Europe PMC XML (HTTP 500), so they were skipped.

Contamination check: contamination_title_abstract is empty for all 10. Some bodies mention pancreatic cell lines or tissues in passing (E2, E3, E4, E9); none names pancreatic cancer in the title, abstract or keywords. No KRAS-in-pancreas paper was used.

Corrections to extractor output are recorded per exemplar: STAR★Methods are not recognised as Methods by jats_structure.py, so Methods words for E2, E4 and E10 were added by hand from the section tree; graphical abstracts, Key Resources Tables, keyword lines and duplicated supplement listings were removed from counts.
Limitation frequencies come from reading the Discussion/Limitations text of each exemplar and are approximate (+/-1).
No exemplar cites MDAR, ARRIVE or any CRISPR-screen reporting standard; MIACARM was checked and is a regenerative-medicine cellular-assay standard, not a CRISPR one.
DepMap release DOIs verified: DepMap 23Q4 Public = 10.25452/figshare.plus.24667905.v2 (Figshare+). Chronos: Dempster JM et al. Genome Biol 2021, 10.1186/s13059-021-02540-7.
New display-item id not in the shared vocabulary: target_prioritisation_plot (target-priority score figure; E7, E10).
E7 (npj Precision Oncology) has only 19 references (confirmed with Crossref); excluding it the reference range is 53-124.
